subject: Renewal runway and SLA credit request — usage & latency recap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@clearstream.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearstream.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal runway and SLA credit request — usage & latency recap

Hey Maya —

Hope you had a good week. Ahead of ClearStream's renewal in mid-March I wanted to share a short recap of the last 12 months and propose a modest runway + SLA credit we can add to smooth the term transition. Quick bullets: 

- Current committed tier: 120M tokens/month (annual term)
- Current average monthly usage: 85M tokens (peak 170M in Nov 2027 after feature launch)
- Observed 95th-latency across key routes (chat/generation): 90–140ms depending on model mix; 120ms P95 is our baseline SLO right now
- Cost per 1M tokens (current): $75 / 1M (hosted plan with reserved bursts)

We heard from your engineering team that the November spike drove some latency sensitivity and you'd like a firmer P95 target if we expand the commit. To help with that we can: 

1) Offer a one-quarter runway: 3 months of flexible burst credit equal to 25% of your committed capacity to handle onboarding/launch spikes.
2) Add an SLA credit clause for sustained P95 > 150ms across the month (tied to per-route degradation).
3) Include a short ROI appendix showing cost delta vs. self-hosted options and token-economics by model mix.

If you're open, I'd like to schedule a 30-min sync early next week with procurement + your infra lead to walk the proposal and the latency bench table. I attached a compact proposal draft for quick review.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal summary), Latency_Benchmarks_Q4.csv (P50/P95/P99 per route)
From: Maya Patel <maya@clearstream.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearstream.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway and SLA credit request — usage & latency recap

Thanks, Karthik — and appreciate the summary. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement is focused on predictable monthly spend. Can you show the blended unit price if we do a 24-month committed tier at 150M tokens/month?
- Our infra lead (Samir) asked if the proposed SLA applies per-region (we have EU traffic routed via our EU VPC) — we need a regional P95 carve-out if possible.
- The runway credit sounds useful. Can you clarify whether the 25% applies as burst credits only or can it be consumed as carry-forward if not used in a month?

I can put procurement + Samir on a call next Tue 10am PT. Please confirm.

Best,
Maya
Head of Product, ClearStream
maya@clearstream.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal runway and SLA credit request — ClearStream call prep

Laura / Ben — forwarding Maya's reply and the attached draft. High level asks from ClearStream: a blended price if they commit 24 months at 150M tokens/mo, regional SLA carve-outs (EU), and clarification on whether runway credits are burst-only or carry-forward.

Suggested approach: 
- Offer a 12–18% price break on blended unit price for 24-month commit (+ guaranteed burst capacity). I ran a quick calc that lands near $65 / 1M blended (includes reserved burst uplift + support add-on).
- Make SLA credit regional: P95 measured per-region with a centralized fallback; if EU P95 > 160ms monthly we apply the credit (slightly relaxed from global baseline to reflect cross-region networking).
- Make runway credits single-quarter burst-only, but allow one-time rollover of unused portion into the next month (but not beyond). That keeps financial predictability.

Can you quick-check the blended pricing and compliance with our quota exposure model? Also should we include a 2-week pilot of Dedicated capacity for their highest-traffic routes as a paid add-on (would accelerate latency gains)?

Thanks —
Karthik

Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway and SLA credit request — usage & latency recap (proposal attached)

Maya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for coordinating the Tue call. Confirmed for Tue 10am PT — I've attached an updated proposal that includes: 

- Blended pricing for 24 months at 150M tokens/mo: $64.50 / 1M tokens (net of standard platform discount + reserved burst uplift).
- A regional SLA framing: P95 measured per-region with a credit trigger at EU P95 > 160ms and US P95 > 150ms. Credits calculated as % of monthly spend with a not-to-exceed cap.
- Runway credit clarified: 25% of committed capacity available as burst credits during the first quarter; unused portion can be rolled into the following month once (one-time rollover) but expires after that quarter.
- Optional 2-week Dedicated pilot for EU routed routes: costed as a separate line item (one-time) and expected to reduce P95 by ~30–45ms on the pilot routes.

I attached the proposal (Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf) and the latency bench CSV so Samir can scan the route-level numbers before we meet. If anything else you want reflected in the doc let me know and I'll update ahead of the call.

See you Tue —
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
